name: glute ham developer hip extension
description: A hip extension on a glute ham developer. You hinge at the hips with a straight body to work the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set up on the GHD with your feet planted and hips just past the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to raise back to a straight line.
Do not arch past neutral at the top.
